moves.label: Quick Tail Jab
moves.description: Fast high tail jab with a short active window that checks close pressure.

moves.label: Low Tail Scythe
moves.description: Fast low tail sweep with very long active coverage as Frieza slides across the floor.

moves.label: Tail Backhand
moves.description: Quick mid tail slap with a short active window after a small body turn.

moves.label: Heavy Tail Wheel
moves.description: Slow mid tail wheel with committed recovery after a broad spinning arc.
